##------------Controls Sankey plot --------------------
make_sankey_controls <- function(df, points_col, colors_custom, clinvar, label_nodes = FALSE) {

  df <- df %>% mutate(clinvar = {{ clinvar }})

  # Fix clinvar naming
  df$clinvar[df$clinvar == 'Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic'] <- "Likely pathogenic"
  df$clinvar[df$clinvar == 'Benign/Likely benign'] <- "Likely benign"

  # Dynamically pick the points column using {{ }}
  summary_data <- df %>%
    group_by(clinvar, {{ points_col }}) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

  # Expand the dataframe
  expanded_df <- summary_data[rep(1:nrow(summary_data), summary_data$count), -3]
  rownames(expanded_df) <- NULL

  # Prepare for sankey
  sankey_data <- expanded_df %>%
    ggsankey::make_long(clinvar, {{ points_col }})

  # Factor levels
  levels_order <- c(
    'Benign', "Likely benign", "Likely Benign",
    'Uncertain', "No Classification",
    "Likely pathogenic", "Likely Pathogenic", "Pathogenic"
  )

  sankey_data$node <- factor(sankey_data$node, levels = levels_order)
  sankey_data$next_node <- factor(sankey_data$next_node, levels = levels_order)

  # Make the plot
  gc <- ggplot(sankey_data, aes(
    x = x,
    next_x = next_x,
    node = node,
    next_node = next_node,
    fill = node,
    label = if (label_nodes) node else NA
  )) +
    geom_sankey(flow.alpha = 0.7, node.color = "black") +
    geom_sankey_label(size = 3, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_custom) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Sankey Diagram: ClinVar → ", rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(points_col))),
      fill = "Node Category"
    )

  return(gc)
}

##----- confusion matrix function ----
make_confusion_matrix_controls_chek2 <- function(df, points_col, clnsig_col, predictor, func_col, pred_col) {

  # ---- Collapse ClinVar ----
  df[[clnsig_col]] <- dplyr::case_when(
    df[[clnsig_col]] %in% c("Likely pathogenic", "Likely Pathogenic", "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic") ~ "Pathogenic",
    df[[clnsig_col]] %in% c("Likely benign", "Likely Benign", "Benign/Likely benign") ~ "Benign",
    TRUE ~ df[[clnsig_col]]
  )

  # ---- Collapse POINTS the same way ----
  df[[points_col]] <- dplyr::case_when(
    df[[points_col]] %in% c("Likely pathogenic", "Likely Pathogenic", "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic") ~ "Pathogenic",
    df[[points_col]] %in% c("Likely benign", "Likely Benign", "Benign/Likely benign") ~ "Benign",
    TRUE ~ df[[points_col]]
  )

  # ---- Only determinates ----
  df_det <- df[df[[points_col]] %in% c("Pathogenic", "Benign"), ]

  # ---- All possible combinations ----
  all_levels <- tidyr::expand_grid(
    clnsig = c("Benign", "Pathogenic"),
    points = c("Benign", "Pathogenic")
  )

  # ---- Summary table ----
  summary_data <- df_det %>%
    dplyr::count(
      clnsig = .data[[clnsig_col]],
      points = .data[[points_col]],
      name = "count"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::right_join(all_levels, by = c("clnsig", "points")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      count = tidyr::replace_na(count, 0),
      consistency = ifelse(clnsig == points, "Consistent", "Inconsistent"),
      fill_status = ifelse(count == 0, "Zero", consistency)
    )

  # ---- Extract confusion matrix values ----
  TP <- summary_data$count[summary_data$clnsig == "Pathogenic" & summary_data$points == "Pathogenic"]
  TN <- summary_data$count[summary_data$clnsig == "Benign"     & summary_data$points == "Benign"]
  FP <- summary_data$count[summary_data$clnsig == "Benign"     & summary_data$points == "Pathogenic"]
  FN <- summary_data$count[summary_data$clnsig == "Pathogenic" & summary_data$points == "Benign"]

  TP <- sum(TP); TN <- sum(TN); FP <- sum(FP); FN <- sum(FN)

  # ---- Metrics ----
  sensitivity  <- TP / (TP + FN)
  specificity  <- TN / (TN + FP)
  concordance  <- (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN)
  
  denominator <- sqrt(
  as.numeric(TP + FP) *
  as.numeric(TP + FN) *
  as.numeric(TN + FP) *
  as.numeric(TN + FN)
)
  
  mcc <- ((TP * TN) - (FP * FN)) / denominator
  
  mcc <- ((TP * TN) - (FP * FN)) / denominator

  # convert NaN to 0
  mcc <- ifelse(is.nan(mcc) | is.infinite(mcc), 0, mcc)

  percent_classified <- (TP + TN + FP + FN) / nrow(df)

  metrics_df <- data.frame(
    TP = TP, TN = TN, FP = FP, FN = FN,
    Sensitivity = round(sensitivity, 3),
    Specificity = round(specificity, 3),
    Concordance = round(concordance, 3),
    MCC = round(mcc, 3),
    Determinate_calls = round(percent_classified, 3)
  )
  
  #----- FP,FN Stats ----
  
  # Identify row-level FP and FN
  FP_rows <- df[df[[clnsig_col]] == "Benign"     & df[[points_col]] == "Pathogenic", ]
  FN_rows <- df[df[[clnsig_col]] == "Pathogenic" & df[[points_col]] == "Benign", ]

  
  get_stats <- function(df, func_col, pred_col) {
  
  func_vals <- df[[func_col]]
  pred_vals <- df[[pred_col]]
  
  has_func <- func_vals != 0 & !is.na(func_vals)
  has_pred <- pred_vals != 0 & !is.na(pred_vals)
  
  both <- has_func & has_pred
  
  same_direction <- both & (sign(func_vals) == sign(pred_vals))
  opp_direction  <- both & (sign(func_vals) != sign(pred_vals))
  
  # 4-way direction breakdown (only for opposite-direction variants)
  opp <- opp_direction

  opp_func_pos <- sum(opp & func_vals > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  opp_func_neg <- sum(opp & func_vals < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  opp_pred_pos <- sum(opp & pred_vals > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  opp_pred_neg <- sum(opp & pred_vals < 0, na.rm = TRUE)

  data.frame(
    total                = nrow(df),
    func_nonzero         = sum(has_func),
    pred_nonzero         = sum(has_pred),
    both_nonzero         = sum(both),
    same_direction       = sum(same_direction),
    opposite_direction   = sum(opp_direction),
    only_functional      = sum(has_func & !has_pred),
    only_predictor       = sum(has_pred & !has_func),
    
    opp_func_positive     = opp_func_pos,
    opp_func_negative     = opp_func_neg,
    opp_pred_positive     = opp_pred_pos,
    opp_pred_negative     = opp_pred_neg
  )
  }
  
  FP_stats <- get_stats(FP_rows, func_col, pred_col)
  FN_stats <- get_stats(FN_rows, func_col, pred_col)
  
  FP_stats$predictor <- predictor
  FN_stats$predictor <- predictor

  # ---- Plot ----
  p <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = clnsig, y = points, fill = fill_status)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = count), size = 6, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Consistent" = "#D8BFD8",
      "Inconsistent" = "#F2F2F2",
      "Zero" = "white"
    )) +
    labs(
      x = "ClinVar",
      y = paste0("Experimental + Predictive classification (", predictor, ")"),
      title = paste0(
        "(Determinates = ", nrow(df_det),
        ", Total = ", nrow(df),
        ", Error = ", round((FP + FN) / nrow(df) * 100, 2), "%)"
      )
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  list(plot = p, metrics = metrics_df, summary = summary_data,FP_stats = FP_stats,
  FN_stats = FN_stats)
}

plot_clinvar_metrics <- function(metrics_df) {
  
  # Pivot to long format using your fixed column names
  metrics_long <- metrics_df %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c("Determinate_calls", "MCC", "Specificity", "Sensitivity", "Concordance"),
      names_to = "Metric",
      values_to = "Value"
    )
  
  # Metric ordering
  metrics_long$Metric <- factor(metrics_long$Metric,
                                levels = c("Determinate_calls", "MCC", "Specificity", "Sensitivity", "Concordance"))
  
  # Colors
  predictor_colors <- c(
    "REVEL"         = "black",
    "AlphaMissense" = "darkgrey",
    "MutPred2" = "whitesmoke"
  )
  
  # Plot
  p <- ggplot(metrics_long, 
              aes(y = Metric, x = Value, fill = Predictor)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6, color = 'black') +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Value)),
              position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
              hjust = -0.2, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1.05)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = predictor_colors) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
  
  return(p)
}

metrics_controls_YP = plot_clinvar_metrics(metrics_one_star_YP)


save_my_plot <- function(plot, filename, folder,
                         width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300) {

  # Create folder if it doesn't exist
  if (!dir.exists(folder)) {
    dir.create(folder, recursive = TRUE)
  }

  filepath <- file.path(folder, filename)

  ggsave(
    filename = filepath,
    plot = plot,
    dpi = dpi,
    device = "png",
    bg = "transparent",
    width = width,
    height = height
  )

  message("Saved: ", filepath)
}

# ------ Sankey function for clingen controls ------

make_sankey_clingen <- function(df, points_col, colors_custom, label_nodes = FALSE) {

  df <- df %>%
  filter(Updated_Classification_ClinGen_repo != "VUS")


  # Fix clnsig_group naming
  df$Updated_Classification_ClinGen_repo[df$Updated_Classification_ClinGen_repo == 'Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic'] <- "Likely pathogenic"
  df$Updated_Classification_ClinGen_repo[df$Updated_Classification_ClinGen_repo == 'Benign/Likely benign'] <- "Likely benign"

  # Dynamically pick the points column using {{ }}
  summary_data <- df %>%
    group_by(Updated_Classification_ClinGen_repo, {{ points_col }}) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

  # Expand the dataframe
  expanded_df <- summary_data[rep(1:nrow(summary_data), summary_data$count), -3]
  rownames(expanded_df) <- NULL

  # Prepare for sankey
  sankey_data <- expanded_df %>%
    ggsankey::make_long(Updated_Classification_ClinGen_repo, {{ points_col }})

  # Factor levels
  levels_order <- c(
    'Benign', "Likely benign", "Likely Benign",
    'Uncertain', "No Classification",
    "Likely pathogenic", "Likely Pathogenic", "Pathogenic"
  )

  sankey_data$node <- factor(sankey_data$node, levels = levels_order)
  sankey_data$next_node <- factor(sankey_data$next_node, levels = levels_order)

  # Make the plot
  gc <- ggplot(sankey_data, aes(
    x = x,
    next_x = next_x,
    node = node,
    next_node = next_node,
    fill = node,
    label = if (label_nodes) node else NA
  )) +
    geom_sankey(flow.alpha = 0.7, node.color = "black") +
    geom_sankey_label(size = 3, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_custom) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Sankey Diagram: ClinGen --> ", rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(points_col))),
      fill = "Node Category"
    )

  return(gc)
}

##----- confusion matrix function clingen ----
make_confusion_matrix_clingen <- function(df, points_col, clnsig_col, predictor, func_col, pred_col) {
  
  df <- df[df[[clnsig_col]] != "VUS", ]

  
  # ---- Collapse ClinGen ----
  df[[clnsig_col]] <- dplyr::case_when(
    df[[clnsig_col]] %in% c("Likely pathogenic", "Likely Pathogenic", "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic") ~ "Pathogenic",
    df[[clnsig_col]] %in% c("Likely benign", "Likely Benign", "Benign/Likely benign") ~ "Benign",
    TRUE ~ df[[clnsig_col]]
  )

  # ---- Collapse POINTS the same way ----
  df[[points_col]] <- dplyr::case_when(
    df[[points_col]] %in% c("Likely pathogenic", "Likely Pathogenic", "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic") ~ "Pathogenic",
    df[[points_col]] %in% c("Likely benign", "Likely Benign", "Benign/Likely benign") ~ "Benign",
    TRUE ~ df[[points_col]]
  )

  # ---- Only determinates ----
  df_det <- df[df[[points_col]] %in% c("Pathogenic", "Benign"), ]

  # ---- All possible combinations ----
  all_levels <- tidyr::expand_grid(
    clnsig = c("Benign", "Pathogenic"),
    points = c("Benign", "Pathogenic")
  )

  # ---- Summary table ----
  summary_data <- df_det %>%
    dplyr::count(
      clnsig = .data[[clnsig_col]],
      points = .data[[points_col]],
      name = "count"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::right_join(all_levels, by = c("clnsig", "points")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      count = tidyr::replace_na(count, 0),
      consistency = ifelse(clnsig == points, "Consistent", "Inconsistent"),
      fill_status = ifelse(count == 0, "Zero", consistency)
    )

  # ---- Extract confusion matrix values ----
  TP <- summary_data$count[summary_data$clnsig == "Pathogenic" & summary_data$points == "Pathogenic"]
  TN <- summary_data$count[summary_data$clnsig == "Benign"     & summary_data$points == "Benign"]
  FP <- summary_data$count[summary_data$clnsig == "Benign"     & summary_data$points == "Pathogenic"]
  FN <- summary_data$count[summary_data$clnsig == "Pathogenic" & summary_data$points == "Benign"]

  TP <- sum(TP); TN <- sum(TN); FP <- sum(FP); FN <- sum(FN)

  # ---- Metrics ----
  sensitivity  <- TP / (TP + FN)
  specificity  <- TN / (TN + FP)
  concordance  <- (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN)
  
  denominator <- sqrt(
  as.numeric(TP + FP) *
  as.numeric(TP + FN) *
  as.numeric(TN + FP) *
  as.numeric(TN + FN)
)
  
  mcc <- ((TP * TN) - (FP * FN)) / denominator
  
  mcc <- ((TP * TN) - (FP * FN)) / denominator

  # convert NaN to 0
  mcc <- ifelse(is.nan(mcc) | is.infinite(mcc), 0, mcc)

  percent_classified <- (TP + TN + FP + FN) / nrow(df)

  metrics_df <- data.frame(
    TP = TP, TN = TN, FP = FP, FN = FN,
    Sensitivity = round(sensitivity, 3),
    Specificity = round(specificity, 3),
    Concordance = round(concordance, 3),
    MCC = round(mcc, 3),
    Determinate_calls = round(percent_classified, 3)
  )
  
  #----- FP,FN Stats ----
  
  # Identify row-level FP and FN
  FP_rows <- df[df[[clnsig_col]] == "Benign"     & df[[points_col]] == "Pathogenic", ]
  FN_rows <- df[df[[clnsig_col]] == "Pathogenic" & df[[points_col]] == "Benign", ]

  
  get_stats <- function(df, func_col, pred_col) {
  
  func_vals <- df[[func_col]]
  pred_vals <- df[[pred_col]]
  
  has_func <- func_vals != 0 & !is.na(func_vals)
  has_pred <- pred_vals != 0 & !is.na(pred_vals)
  
  both <- has_func & has_pred
  
  same_direction <- both & (sign(func_vals) == sign(pred_vals))
  opp_direction  <- both & (sign(func_vals) != sign(pred_vals))
  
  # 4-way direction breakdown (only for opposite-direction variants)
  opp <- opp_direction

  opp_func_pos <- sum(opp & func_vals > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  opp_func_neg <- sum(opp & func_vals < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  opp_pred_pos <- sum(opp & pred_vals > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  opp_pred_neg <- sum(opp & pred_vals < 0, na.rm = TRUE)

  data.frame(
    total                = nrow(df),
    func_nonzero         = sum(has_func),
    pred_nonzero         = sum(has_pred),
    both_nonzero         = sum(both),
    same_direction       = sum(same_direction),
    opposite_direction   = sum(opp_direction),
    only_functional      = sum(has_func & !has_pred),
    only_predictor       = sum(has_pred & !has_func),
    
    opp_func_positive     = opp_func_pos,
    opp_func_negative     = opp_func_neg,
    opp_pred_positive     = opp_pred_pos,
    opp_pred_negative     = opp_pred_neg
  )
  }
  
  FP_stats <- get_stats(FP_rows, func_col, pred_col)
  FN_stats <- get_stats(FN_rows, func_col, pred_col)
  
  FP_stats$predictor <- predictor
  FN_stats$predictor <- predictor

  # ---- Plot ----
  p <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = clnsig, y = points, fill = fill_status)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = count), size = 6, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Consistent" = "#D8BFD8",
      "Inconsistent" = "#F2F2F2",
      "Zero" = "white"
    )) +
    labs(
      x = "ClinGen",
      y = paste0("Experimental + Predictive classification (", predictor, ")"),
      title = paste0(
        "(Determinates = ", nrow(df_det),
        ", Total = ", nrow(df),
        ", Error = ", round((FP + FN) / nrow(df) * 100, 2), "%)"
      )
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  list(plot = p, metrics = metrics_df, summary = summary_data,FP_stats = FP_stats,
  FN_stats = FN_stats)
}

#Figure 6a

VUS_REVEL_YP = read_excel(file.path(DATA_DIR, "supplementary_data/Supplementary_Data_5.xlsx"), sheet = "VUS_REVEL")


make_sankey_VUS <- function(df, points_col, colors_custom) {
  
  # Dynamically pick the points column using {{ }}
  summary_data <- df %>%
    group_by(clinvar_sig_2025, {{ points_col }}) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Expand the dataframe
  expanded_df <- summary_data[rep(1:nrow(summary_data), summary_data$count), -3]
  rownames(expanded_df) <- NULL
  
  # Prepare for sankey
  sankey_data <- expanded_df %>%
    ggsankey::make_long(clinvar_sig_2025, {{ points_col }})
  
  # Factor levels
  levels_order <- c(
    -12.0:-1.0, "Uncertain significance","No evidence", "Benign", "Likely benign", "Likely Benign", 
    "Uncertain", "Likely pathogenic", "Likely Pathogenic", "Pathogenic",
    0, "No Classification", "Conflicting evidence", 1.0:12.0
  )
  
  sankey_data$node <- factor(sankey_data$node, levels = levels_order)
  sankey_data$next_node <- factor(sankey_data$next_node, levels = levels_order)
  
  # Make the plot
  gc <- ggplot(sankey_data, aes(
    x = x,
    next_x = next_x,
    node = node,
    next_node = next_node,
    fill = node,
    label = node
  )) +
    geom_sankey(flow.alpha = 0.7, node.color = "black") +
    geom_sankey_label(size = 3, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_custom) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Sankey Diagram: VUS --> ", rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(points_col))),
      fill = "Node Category"
    )
  
  return(gc)
}

sankey_VUS_REVEL_YP <- make_sankey_VUS(VUS_REVEL_YP, Class_REVEL, colors_custom)


make_uncertain_confusion <- function(df, points_col, xlabel) {
  
  points_col_name <- rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(points_col))

  # count predicted categories
  summary_data <- df %>%
    count(pred = .data[[points_col_name]], name = "count")

  # ensure all 5 categories appear
  all_levels <- c("Pathogenic", "Likely Pathogenic",
                  "Benign", "Likely Benign", "Uncertain")

  summary_data <- summary_data %>%
    complete(pred = all_levels, fill = list(count = 0))

  grand_total <- sum(summary_data$count)
  uncertain_count <- summary_data$count[summary_data$pred == "Uncertain"]
  reclass_prop <- round((1 - (uncertain_count / grand_total)) * 100, 2)

  # single-row confusion matrix style plot
  p <- ggplot(summary_data,
              aes(x = pred,
                  y = "ClinVar Uncertain",
                  fill = pred)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = count), size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_custom
    ) +
    labs(
      x = xlabel,
      y = "",
      title = paste0(
        "VUS Reclassification",
        "Total = ", nrow(df),
        " | Reclassifciation = ", reclass_prop, "%"
      )
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )

  return(p)
}

df_classified <- VUS_REVEL_YP %>%
  mutate(
    point_source = case_when(
      Fxn_points != 0 & Points_REVEL_GeneSpecific_GenomeWide == 0 ~ "Functional only",
      Fxn_points == 0 & Points_REVEL_GeneSpecific_GenomeWide != 0 ~ "Predictive only",
      Fxn_points != 0 & Points_REVEL_GeneSpecific_GenomeWide != 0 ~ "Both",
      Fxn_points == 0 & Points_REVEL_GeneSpecific_GenomeWide == 0 ~ "No evidence",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    conflict_status = ifelse(
      Conflicting_REVEL == "Conflicting evidence",
      "Conflicting",
      "No conflict"
    )
  )


# Remove rows that have no point source at all
df_classified <- df_classified %>% filter(point_source != "None")

###------------------------------------------------------------
### 2. Summaries for classification bins
###------------------------------------------------------------

plot_summary <- df_classified %>%
  count(Total_Points_REVEL, point_source, conflict_status) %>%
  complete(
    Total_Points_REVEL,
    point_source = c("Functional only", "Predictive only", "Both"),
    conflict_status = c("Conflicting", "No conflict"),
    fill = list(n = 0))

### Re-bin pathogenicity buckets
plot_summary_2 <- plot_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Total_Points_REVEL = cut(
      Total_Points_REVEL,
      breaks = c(-Inf, -12, -5, -3, 0,0.000001,4, 6, 10, 13, Inf),
      labels = c("< -12", "-12 to -6", "-5 to -4", "-3 to -1","0","1 to 3",
                 "4 to 5", "6 to 9", "10 to 12", "> 12"),
      right = FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Total_Points_REVEL) %>%
  mutate(total_variants = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()


###------------------------------------------------------------
### 3. Compute the 3 rings
###------------------------------------------------------------

build_three_rings <- function(df_subset) {
  
  # ---- Ring 1: inner = Total_Points_REVEL bins ----
  inner_ring <- df_subset %>%
    distinct(Total_Points_REVEL, total_variants) %>%
    arrange(Total_Points_REVEL) %>%
    mutate(
      cum = cumsum(total_variants),
      start = lag(cum, default = 0),
      end = cum
    )
  
  total_sum <- sum(inner_ring$total_variants)
  
  inner_ring <- inner_ring %>%
    mutate(
      start = start / total_sum * 2*pi,
      end   = end   / total_sum * 2*pi,
      r0 = 0.3, 
      r1 = 0.55
    )
  
  # ---- Ring 2: middle = point_source ----
  middle_ring <- df_subset %>%
    group_by(Total_Points_REVEL, point_source) %>%
    summarise(n_middle = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(inner_ring, by = "Total_Points_REVEL") %>%
    group_by(Total_Points_REVEL) %>%
    mutate(
      total_bin = sum(n_middle),
      local_start = lag(cumsum(n_middle), default = 0),
      local_end   = cumsum(n_middle),
      # Capture the bin's own start/end before overwriting them below -- the
      # end formula must divide the *original* bin span, not the already-
      # reassigned start (which it would otherwise pick up in the same
      # mutate(), inflating every category after the first and giving a
      # true-zero-count category a spurious nonzero width).
      bin_start = start,
      bin_end = end,
      start = bin_start + (local_start / total_bin) * (bin_end - bin_start),
      end   = bin_start + (local_end   / total_bin) * (bin_end - bin_start),
      r0 = 0.55,
      r1 = 0.85
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-bin_start, -bin_end)
  
  # ---- Ring 3: outer = conflict_status ----
  outer_ring <- df_subset %>%
    group_by(Total_Points_REVEL, conflict_status) %>%
    summarise(n_outer = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(inner_ring, by = "Total_Points_REVEL") %>%
    group_by(Total_Points_REVEL) %>%
    mutate(
      total_bin = sum(n_outer),
      local_start = lag(cumsum(n_outer), default = 0),
      local_end   = cumsum(n_outer),
      bin_start = start,
      bin_end = end,
      start = bin_start + (local_start / total_bin) * (bin_end - bin_start),
      end   = bin_start + (local_end   / total_bin) * (bin_end - bin_start),
      r0 = 0.85,
      r1 = 1.15
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-bin_start, -bin_end)
  
  list(inner = inner_ring, middle = middle_ring, outer = outer_ring)
}


###------------------------------------------------------------
### 4. Plot function
###------------------------------------------------------------

make_three_ring_plot <- function(df_subset, title = NULL) {
  
  rings <- build_three_rings(df_subset)
  inner_ring  <- rings$inner
  middle_ring <- rings$middle
  outer_ring  <- rings$outer
  
  inner_label <- inner_ring %>%
  mutate(
    mid = (start + end) / 2,
    x = (r0 + r1)/2 * cos(mid - pi/2),
    y = -(r0 + r1)/2 * sin(mid - pi/2),
    label_text = as.character(Total_Points_REVEL)
  )
  
  middle_label <- middle_ring %>%
  mutate(
    mid = (start + end)/2,
    x = (r0 + r1)/2 * cos(mid - pi/2),
    y = -(r0 + r1)/2 * sin(mid - pi/2),
    label_text = n_middle
  )
  
  outer_label <- outer_ring %>%
  mutate(
    mid = (start + end)/2,
    x = (r0 + r1)/2 * cos(mid - pi/2),
    y = -(r0 + r1)/2 * sin(mid - pi/2),
    label_text = n_outer
  )
  
  list(
  inner = inner_ring,
  middle = middle_ring,
  outer = outer_ring,
  inner_label = inner_label,
  middle_label = middle_label,
  outer_label = outer_label
)


  ggplot() +
    geom_arc_bar(
      data = inner_ring,
      aes(x0 = 0, y0 = 0, r0 = r0, r = r1,
          start = start, end = end, fill = Total_Points_REVEL)
    ) +
    geom_arc_bar(
      data = middle_ring,
      aes(x0 = 0, y0 = 0, r0 = r0, r = r1,
          start = start, end = end, fill = point_source)
    ) +
    geom_arc_bar(
      data = outer_ring,
      aes(x0 = 0, y0 = 0, r0 = r0, r = r1,
          start = start, end = end, fill = conflict_status)
    ) + 
    geom_text(
    data = inner_label,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label_text),
    size = 3.8,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # 🔹 Middle ring → NUMBER OF VARIANTS
  geom_text(
    data = middle_label,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label_text),
    size = 3.2,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # 🔹 Outer ring → NUMBER OF VARIANTS
  geom_text(
    data = outer_label,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label_text),
    size = 2.7,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black"
  ) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_void() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_custom) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
    )
}

###------------------------------------------------------------
### 4b. Calibrated donut: real print size, baked-in labels
###------------------------------------------------------------
# Renders at the *exact* final placed size (cairo_pdf, mm units, Arial),
# matching Figure_6b.R's convention -- so at 100% placement scale in the
# assembled figure, text renders at true point size, instead of the
# pie_*_lab.png workflow above (arbitrary 7x7in @300dpi raster, default
# font, hand-finished label placement/sizing in Illustrator). Keep
# generating the lab/nolab versions above; this is an additional variant,
# not a replacement, until it's validated across all three panels.

point_in_mm <- 0.3527778
LABEL_PT <- 5.5
LABEL_MM <- LABEL_PT * point_in_mm
# Smaller size for two-line-wrapped inner-ring labels, matching the original
# hand-placed figure's convention of shrinking text for this specific case.
WRAP_LABEL_PT <- 4.2
WRAP_LABEL_MM <- WRAP_LABEL_PT * point_in_mm
FONT_FAMILY <- "Arial"

# The outer circle's own placed diameter in the assembled figure (mm) -- not
# the panel/canvas width, just the ring itself. Confirmed for the Benign
# panel; assumed identical for Pathogenic/Uncertain since all three donuts
# are laid out as same-size panels in Fig 6c -- confirm if that's not so.
RING_DIAMETER_MM <- 28.7

# Display text for inner-ring bin labels -- reads closer-to-zero value first,
# regardless of how the underlying Total_Points_REVEL bin factor is ordered
# (which also drives colors_custom's keys above, left as-is). Uses the
# Unicode minus sign (U+2212), not a hyphen -- geomtextpath's glyph-curving
# silently drops a plain ASCII hyphen-minus regardless of font (reproduced
# with both Arial and sans), so a hyphen here would render as "1 to  3".
bin_display_labels <- c(
  "< -12" = "< −12",
  "-12 to -6" = "−6 to −12",
  "-5 to -4" = "−4 to −5",
  "-3 to -1" = "−1 to −3",
  "0" = "0",
  "1 to 3" = "1 to 3",
  "4 to 5" = "4 to 5",
  "6 to 9" = "6 to 9",
  "10 to 12" = "10 to 12",
  "> 12" = "> 12"
)

# Device-independent-ish text width in mm, via grid (resolves Arial through
# fontconfig on the r-figures container's default cairo_pdf device).
text_width_mm <- function(label, pt = LABEL_PT, family = FONT_FAMILY) {
  gp <- gpar(fontfamily = family, fontsize = pt)
  vapply(
    label,
    function(l) convertWidth(grobWidth(textGrob(l, gp = gp)), "mm", valueOnly = TRUE),
    numeric(1)
  )
}

# angle=0 is 12 o'clock, increasing clockwise -- same convention as the
# inner_label/middle_label/outer_label x/y formulas above.
polar_xy <- function(r, angle) {
  tibble(x = r * cos(angle - pi/2), y = -r * sin(angle - pi/2))
}

arc_length_mm <- function(r, theta, mm_per_unit) r * theta * mm_per_unit
chord_mm <- function(r, theta, mm_per_unit) 2 * r * sin(theta / 2) * mm_per_unit

# For a horizontal label at radius r, angle theta (0/2pi = top, pi = bottom,
# pi/2 & 3pi/2 = sides), the room before hitting either straight radial
# boundary scales with |r * cos(theta)| -- maximal toward the top/bottom of
# the wedge, minimal toward the sides. Reposition within [start, end] toward
# whichever of {0, pi, 2pi} is reachable, keeping a margin off both edges so
# the label doesn't crowd the wedge boundary lines.
best_horizontal_angle <- function(start, end, margin_frac = 0.15) {
  theta <- end - start
  margin <- max(theta * margin_frac, 0.02)
  lo <- start + margin
  hi <- end - margin
  if (lo >= hi) return((start + end) / 2)
  candidates <- c(lo, hi)
  ks <- seq(floor(lo / pi), ceiling(hi / pi))
  interior <- ks * pi
  interior <- interior[interior >= lo & interior <= hi]
  candidates <- c(candidates, interior)
  candidates[which.max(abs(cos(candidates)))]
}

WIDE_WEDGE_THRESHOLD_RAD <- 80 * pi / 180

# Only reposition wide wedges (>80 degrees) whose bisector sits close to the
# 90/270-degree sides, where horizontal room is genuinely short -- not near
# the 0/180-degree top/bottom, where it's already generous (chord_mm can't
# tell these apart: it's the same number for a wedge centered at either
# position, even though the true room at the bisector differs a lot -- see
# best_horizontal_angle's |r*cos(theta)| reasoning). Narrow wedges, and wide
# ones already centered near the top/bottom, are left at their bisector.
needs_reposition <- function(start, end, cos_threshold = 0.5) {
  theta <- end - start
  if (theta <= WIDE_WEDGE_THRESHOLD_RAD) return(FALSE)
  mid <- (start + end) / 2
  abs(cos(mid)) < cos_threshold
}

# White text on dark/saturated fills (e.g. the "-12 to -6" navy, "Functional
# only" teal), black text otherwise -- generalizes across panels instead of
# hardcoding which categories are "dark".
text_color_for_fill <- function(fill_value) {
  hex <- colors_custom[fill_value]
  vapply(hex, function(h) {
    if (is.na(h)) return("black")
    rgb <- grDevices::col2rgb(h) / 255
    luminance <- 0.299 * rgb[1] + 0.587 * rgb[2] + 0.114 * rgb[3]
    if (luminance < 0.5) "white" else "black"
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

# Balanced two-line word-wrap (not greedy) -- for "10 to 12" gives
# c("10", "to 12") rather than piling words onto the first line. Returns
# c(line1, NA) if the label has no space to break on.
wrap_two_lines <- function(label) {
  words <- strsplit(label, " ")[[1]]
  if (length(words) < 2) return(c(label, NA_character_))
  best <- c(label, NA_character_)
  best_diff <- Inf
  for (i in seq_len(length(words) - 1)) {
    l1 <- paste(words[1:i], collapse = " ")
    l2 <- paste(words[(i + 1):length(words)], collapse = " ")
    d <- abs(nchar(l1) - nchar(l2))
    if (d < best_diff) {
      best_diff <- d
      best <- c(l1, l2)
    }
  }
  best
}

make_three_ring_plot_calibrated <- function(df_subset, ring_diameter_mm = RING_DIAMETER_MM) {

  outer_r_max <- 1.15
  mm_per_unit <- ring_diameter_mm / (outer_r_max * 2)

  rings <- build_three_rings(df_subset)

  # ---- classify each label as "inside" (fits) or "outside" (leader line) ----
  # Curved (inner-ring) text follows the arc exactly, so arc length is a
  # precise measure of the space available; straight text at r_mid in a
  # tapering wedge only approximately fits within the chord width, so it
  # keeps a bigger safety margin.
  fit_fudge_straight <- 0.85
  fit_fudge_curved <- 0.95
  EXT_R <- outer_r_max + 0.15   # leader-line/label radius, same for every ring

  classify_ring <- function(ring_df, count_col, fill_col, curved = FALSE, relabel = FALSE) {
    fit_fudge <- if (curved) fit_fudge_curved else fit_fudge_straight
    ring_df %>%
      mutate(theta = end - start) %>%
      filter(theta > 1e-9) %>%   # skip zero-size regions entirely -- nothing to label
      mutate(
        mid = (start + end) / 2,
        r_mid = (r0 + r1) / 2,
        label_text = as.character(.data[[count_col]]),
        label_text = if (relabel) unname(bin_display_labels[label_text]) else label_text,
        avail_mm = if (curved) arc_length_mm(r_mid, theta, mm_per_unit)
                   else chord_mm(r_mid, theta, mm_per_unit),
        text_mm = text_width_mm(label_text),
        fits = text_mm < avail_mm * fit_fudge,
        text_color = text_color_for_fill(as.character(.data[[fill_col]]))
      )
  }

  inner_ring  <- classify_ring(rings$inner,  "Total_Points_REVEL", "Total_Points_REVEL", curved = TRUE, relabel = TRUE)
  middle_ring <- classify_ring(rings$middle, "n_middle", "point_source")
  outer_ring  <- classify_ring(rings$outer,  "n_outer", "conflict_status")

  # For a curved label too wide for one line, try splitting it into two
  # shorter lines stacked within the ring's own radial band, set a size
  # smaller (WRAP_LABEL_PT) -- matches how the original hand-placed figure
  # handled "10 to 12" -- before falling back to an external leader line.
  fit_fudge_wrap <- 0.95
  inner_ring <- inner_ring %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      wrap_line1 = if (!fits) wrap_two_lines(label_text)[1] else NA_character_,
      wrap_line2 = if (!fits) wrap_two_lines(label_text)[2] else NA_character_,
      wrap_fits = !fits && !is.na(wrap_line2) &&
        max(text_width_mm(wrap_line1, pt = WRAP_LABEL_PT), text_width_mm(wrap_line2, pt = WRAP_LABEL_PT)) <
          avail_mm * fit_fudge_wrap
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  # ---- inside placements ----
  # Straight (non-curved) labels reposition toward the top/bottom of their
  # own wedge, where horizontal room is greatest (see best_horizontal_angle) --
  # but only for wide, genuinely-crowded wedges (see needs_reposition);
  # curved inner-ring text follows the whole arc so this doesn't apply to it.
  inner_inside <- inner_ring %>% filter(fits)
  inner_inside_wrapped <- inner_ring %>% filter(!fits & wrap_fits)
  middle_inside_xy <- middle_ring %>% filter(fits) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      label_angle = if (needs_reposition(start, end))
        best_horizontal_angle(start, end) else mid
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    bind_cols(polar_xy(.$r_mid, .$label_angle))
  outer_inside_xy <- outer_ring %>% filter(fits) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      label_angle = if (needs_reposition(start, end))
        best_horizontal_angle(start, end) else mid
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    bind_cols(polar_xy(.$r_mid, .$label_angle))

  # ---- outside placements (any ring, fallback for inner too) ----
  # Non-outermost rings anchor their leader line at their own mid-radius,
  # not r1 -- starting exactly on a ring boundary reads as a continuation of
  # that boundary's wedge divisions in the ring(s) outside it. The outermost
  # ring has nothing beyond its own r1 to be confused with, so it keeps it.
  make_outside <- function(ring_df, anchor_at_mid = TRUE) {
    if (nrow(ring_df) == 0) return(ring_df)
    ring_df %>%
      mutate(r_anchor = if (anchor_at_mid) r_mid else r1) %>%
      bind_cols(polar_xy(.$r_anchor, .$mid) %>% rename(x_anchor = x, y_anchor = y)) %>%
      bind_cols(polar_xy(EXT_R, .$mid)) %>%
      mutate(
        hjust = case_when(
          x > 0.02 ~ 0,
          x < -0.02 ~ 1,
          TRUE ~ 0.5
        ),
        # Side labels (hjust 0/1) already clear the leader line -- the line
        # ends at the text's near edge, not its middle. Near-vertical labels
        # (hjust 0.5) need the same treatment on the vertical axis: anchor at
        # the near edge (bottom of text if above the ring, top if below) so
        # the line ends at the label instead of running into its middle.
        vjust = case_when(
          hjust != 0.5 ~ 0.5,
          y > 0 ~ 0,
          TRUE ~ 1
        )
      )
  }
  inner_outside  <- make_outside(inner_ring  %>% filter(!fits & !wrap_fits), anchor_at_mid = TRUE)
  middle_outside <- make_outside(middle_ring %>% filter(!fits), anchor_at_mid = TRUE)
  outer_outside  <- make_outside(outer_ring  %>% filter(!fits), anchor_at_mid = FALSE)
  all_outside <- bind_rows(inner_outside, middle_outside, outer_outside)

  # ---- canvas: keep the ring itself pixel-identical across panels; only
  # grow the coordinate range (and physical canvas) to fit outside labels ----
  if (nrow(all_outside) > 0) {
    max_label_mm <- max(all_outside$text_mm)
    x_pad <- max_label_mm / mm_per_unit
    y_pad <- (LABEL_MM + 1) / mm_per_unit
  } else {
    x_pad <- 0
    y_pad <- 0
  }
  x_range <- c(-(EXT_R + x_pad), EXT_R + x_pad)
  y_range <- c(-(EXT_R + y_pad), EXT_R + y_pad)

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_arc_bar(
      data = rings$inner,
      aes(x0 = 0, y0 = 0, r0 = r0, r = r1, start = start, end = end,
          fill = Total_Points_REVEL),
      linewidth = 0.5 * point_in_mm, color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_arc_bar(
      data = rings$middle,
      aes(x0 = 0, y0 = 0, r0 = r0, r = r1, start = start, end = end,
          fill = point_source),
      linewidth = 0.5 * point_in_mm, color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_arc_bar(
      data = rings$outer,
      aes(x0 = 0, y0 = 0, r0 = r0, r = r1, start = start, end = end,
          fill = conflict_status),
      linewidth = 0.5 * point_in_mm, color = "black"
    )

  if (nrow(inner_inside) > 0) {
    # geomtextpath's vjust=0.5 centers the font's full ascent+descent box on
    # the path; our labels (digits/"to"/minus sign) never have descenders, so
    # the visible glyphs sit high (toward larger radius) within that box.
    # Nudge the path radius inward by a fixed physical amount to compensate --
    # proportional to font size, not ring size, since it's a font-metrics
    # effect, so it holds across panels/ring diameters.
    inward_nudge_mm <- 0.3
    arc_pts <- inner_inside %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      reframe(
        Total_Points_REVEL = Total_Points_REVEL,
        label_text = label_text,
        angle = seq(start, end, length.out = 40),
        r_mid = r_mid - inward_nudge_mm / mm_per_unit,
        text_color = text_color
      ) %>%
      bind_cols(polar_xy(.$r_mid, .$angle))
    p <- p + geom_textpath(
      data = arc_pts,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = label_text, group = Total_Points_REVEL,
          color = text_color),
      size = LABEL_MM, family = FONT_FAMILY,
      upright = TRUE, hjust = 0.5, text_only = TRUE
    )
  }
  if (nrow(inner_inside_wrapped) > 0) {
    # Font-metrics nudge scales with font size (see the single-line case
    # above); line_gap is snug (1x font size, center-to-center) since these
    # are short fragments that read fine close together, and it directly
    # trades off against how much radial room is left within the ring band.
    inward_nudge_mm <- 0.3 * (WRAP_LABEL_PT / LABEL_PT)
    line_gap_mm <- WRAP_LABEL_MM * 1.0
    half_gap_r <- (line_gap_mm / 2) / mm_per_unit
    base_r <- inner_inside_wrapped$r_mid - inward_nudge_mm / mm_per_unit
    # Which physical radius (page-space, not path-space) reads as "line 1" (on
    # top) depends on which half of the circle the wedge sits in: in the
    # upper half, larger radius = higher on the page; in the lower half, it's
    # reversed. polar_xy's y = r*cos(angle) at the bisector gives that sign.
    page_y_sign <- sign(cos((inner_inside_wrapped$start + inner_inside_wrapped$end) / 2))
    build_wrapped_line <- function(line_col, r_sign) {
      inner_inside_wrapped %>%
        mutate(r_mid_line = base_r + r_sign * page_y_sign * half_gap_r) %>%
        rowwise() %>%
        reframe(
          Total_Points_REVEL = Total_Points_REVEL,
          label_text = .data[[line_col]],
          angle = seq(start, end, length.out = 40),
          r_mid = r_mid_line,
          text_color = text_color
        ) %>%
        bind_cols(polar_xy(.$r_mid, .$angle))
    }
    arc_pts_l1 <- build_wrapped_line("wrap_line1", +1)
    arc_pts_l2 <- build_wrapped_line("wrap_line2", -1)
    p <- p +
      geom_textpath(
        data = arc_pts_l1,
        aes(x = x, y = y, label = label_text, group = Total_Points_REVEL,
            color = text_color),
        size = WRAP_LABEL_MM, family = FONT_FAMILY,
        upright = TRUE, hjust = 0.5, text_only = TRUE
      ) +
      geom_textpath(
        data = arc_pts_l2,
        aes(x = x, y = y, label = label_text, group = Total_Points_REVEL,
            color = text_color),
        size = WRAP_LABEL_MM, family = FONT_FAMILY,
        upright = TRUE, hjust = 0.5, text_only = TRUE
      )
  }
  if (nrow(middle_inside_xy) > 0) {
    p <- p + geom_text(
      data = middle_inside_xy,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = label_text, color = text_color),
      size = LABEL_MM, family = FONT_FAMILY
    )
  }
  if (nrow(outer_inside_xy) > 0) {
    p <- p + geom_text(
      data = outer_inside_xy,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = label_text, color = text_color),
      size = LABEL_MM, family = FONT_FAMILY
    )
  }
  if (nrow(all_outside) > 0) {
    p <- p +
      geom_segment(
        data = all_outside,
        aes(x = x_anchor, y = y_anchor, xend = x, yend = y),
        color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5 * point_in_mm
      ) +
      geom_text(
        data = all_outside,
        aes(x = x, y = y, label = label_text, hjust = hjust, vjust = vjust),
        size = LABEL_MM, family = FONT_FAMILY, color = "black"
      )
  }

  p <- p +
    coord_fixed(xlim = x_range, ylim = y_range, expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
    theme_void() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_custom) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

  list(
    plot = p,
    width_mm = diff(x_range) * mm_per_unit,
    height_mm = diff(y_range) * mm_per_unit,
    ring_diameter_mm = 2 * outer_r_max * mm_per_unit
  )
}

### 5. Build plots for bins (pathogenic / uncertain / benign)
###------------------------------------------------------------

gnomad_REVEL_YP = read_excel(file.path(DATA_DIR, "supplementary_data/Supplementary_Data_5.xlsx"), sheet = "gnomAD_REVEL")

make_sankey_gnomad <- function(df, points_col, colors_custom) {
  
  df$gnomad = 'Gnomad'
  
  # Dynamically pick the points column using {{ }}
  summary_data <- df %>%
    group_by(gnomad, {{ points_col }}) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Expand the dataframe
  expanded_df <- summary_data[rep(1:nrow(summary_data), summary_data$count), -3]
  rownames(expanded_df) <- NULL
  
  # Prepare for sankey
  sankey_data <- expanded_df %>%
    ggsankey::make_long(gnomad, {{ points_col }})
  
  # Factor levels
  levels_order <- c(
    -12:-1, "Gnomad","No evidence", "Benign", "Likely benign", "Likely Benign", 
    "Uncertain", "Likely pathogenic", "Likely Pathogenic", "Pathogenic",
    0, "No Classification", "Conflicting evidence", 1:12 
  )
  
  sankey_data$node <- factor(sankey_data$node, levels = levels_order)
  sankey_data$next_node <- factor(sankey_data$next_node, levels = levels_order)
  
  # Make the plot
  gc <- ggplot(sankey_data, aes(
    x = x,
    next_x = next_x,
    node = node,
    next_node = next_node,
    fill = node,
    label = NA
  )) +
    geom_sankey(flow.alpha = 0.7, node.color = "black") +
    geom_sankey_label(size = 3, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_custom) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Sankey Diagram: gnomad --> ", rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(points_col))),
      fill = "Node Category"
    )
  
  return(gc)
}

sankey_gnomad_REVEL_YP = make_sankey_gnomad(gnomad_REVEL_YP, Class_REVEL, colors_custom)
sankey_gnomad_REVEL_YP

make_gnomad_confusion <- function(df, points_col, xlabel) {
  
  points_col_name <- rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(points_col))

  # count predicted categories
  summary_data <- df %>%
    count(pred = .data[[points_col_name]], name = "count")

  # ensure all 5 categories appear
  all_levels <- c("Pathogenic", "Likely Pathogenic",
                  "Benign", "Likely Benign", "Uncertain")

  summary_data <- summary_data %>%
    complete(pred = all_levels, fill = list(count = 0))

  grand_total <- sum(summary_data$count)
  uncertain_count <- summary_data$count[summary_data$pred == "Uncertain"]
  reclass_prop <- round((1 - (uncertain_count / grand_total)) * 100, 2)

  # single-row confusion matrix style plot
  p <- ggplot(summary_data,
              aes(x = pred,
                  y = "ClinVar Uncertain",
                  fill = pred)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = count), size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_custom
    ) +
    labs(
      x = xlabel,
      y = "",
      title = paste0(
        "Gnomad Reclassification",
        "Total = ", nrow(df),
        " | Reclassifciation = ", reclass_prop, "%"
      )
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )

  return(p)
}
